{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100  # Convert to percent

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rate_by_site = response_rate_by_site.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Print results for all sites
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Return the highest response rate site
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.index[0]
print(f"\nHighest response rate site: {highest_site}")"}
